about: Archetype tags of a team sheet for the team-preview opening book (issue #458): which abilities, moves and items give a team which tag. A feature for a prior, not a battle rule: the search still decides. Checked by python -m duoforge_search.archetypes --check.
credits: Tag families: issue #458 (owner, 2026-10-13): weather, speed control, setup, support.

Weather setters are not listed here: they are the engine's own weather-setter abilities (duoforge_data_ability_static, family WEATHER_SETTER), and a Mega Stone gives the tags of its Mega forme's ability (duoforge_data_item_static, duoforge_data_forme_static).
Supplemented from the role names of Smogon's Champions dex VGC sets (data/book/smogon-dex-vgc-2026-10.json, with thanks to Smogon): Clangorous Soul, screens, Electro Shot, Solar Beam.
Move, ability and item names: the engine's pool data (Pokemon Showdown's data, see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
